A separately implemented Fraction audit reconstructs 24 fixed original-model reference contexts and 72 certificate resolutions; it is distinct from the complete-record arithmetic audit. Deterministic catalogue means and exact policy identities are no longer described as population equivalence inference. D independently constructs all 96 current arm/service/risk mean policy-value intervals and all 56 arm contrasts. With the fixed left-minus-right arm ordering, the 56 contrasts comprise 32 strictly negative, 20 strictly positive, 2 exact-zero and 2 unresolved intervals. The 64-cell resolution and 32 rational terminal steps were frozen before D but after the known A/B/C catalogue, without a favorable-sign gate. These are deterministic enclosures, not a calibrated economic margin or a powered population design.
